roleContract.scoreUse: Past FT score used only as prospective base-history input; never a filter by win/loss or candidate performance.

warmup.denominatorScope: One earliest stored future target per league at shared actual census cutoff; all team counts describe historical league team universe, not necessarily current promoted/relegated rosters.

payload.launchScope: Foundation readiness only. No first-run authorization and no real R1 prediction. Structural observed-history eligibility does not claim model output or performance.

observationStore.observationHashField: Canonical envelope sha256 is observationHash; values remain LOCAL_ONLY.

snapshotGradeContract.gradeCorrections: Append-only numbered revision linked to prior hash.

handoff.next: CTO review and separate first-run authorization. Never rerun a historical/holdout evaluator or change parameters.
